entities.summary: Marcos Orlando Letelier del Solar was a Chilean Marxist and diplomat during the presidency of Salvador Allende. A member of the Socialist Party of Chile, he fled from the military dictatorship of General Augusto Pinochet, Letelier accepted several academic positions in Washington D.C. after his exile from Chile. In 1976, agents of Dirección de Inteligencia Nacional (DINA), the Pinochet regime's secret police, killed him in Washington by a car bomb. The agents had been working in collaboration with members of the Coordination of United Revolutionary Organizations, an anti-Castro militant group.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Orlando Letelier's assassination in 1976 by agents of General Pinochet's regime had significant regional impact, as it heightened tensions between Chile and the US, contributing to a deterioration of diplomatic relations and the eventual collapse of Allende's government.
